按钮控制一台三相电机：启动、自锁、停止、热过载保护。PLC 入门第一课。: Control a three-phase motor with pushbuttons: start, seal-in, stop, and thermal overload protection. The first lesson in PLC basics.
输送电机 M1 热继电器正常（常闭）: Conveyor motor M1 overload relay healthy (NC)
自锁就是\"启动按钮 OR 电机自己的输出\"作为启动条件。: Seal-in means using "Start button OR the motor's own output" as the start condition.
停止按钮是常闭触点：没按时为 TRUE，所以要串在条件里（AND STOP），而: The Stop button is a normally closed contact: it is TRUE when not pressed, so wire it in series with the conditions (AND STOP), not as AND NOT STOP.
热继电器的常闭触点 M1_OL_OK 和停止按钮一样串在条件里。: Wire the thermal overload relay's normally closed contact M1_OL_OK in series with the conditions, just like the Stop button.
按启动电机运行: Press Start to run the motor
按一下启动（按下就松手），电机 M1_RUN 应该马上变 1: Tap Start and release it. Motor M1_RUN should immediately become 1.
松开按钮后保持运行（自锁）: Keep the motor running after releasing the button (seal-in).
按一下启动后松开，电机要继续运行至少 3 秒（自锁）: After tapping Start and releasing it, the motor must keep running for at least 3 seconds (seal-in).
按停止电机停止: Press Stop to stop the motor
电机转着的时候按一下停止：1 秒内停，松开停止后也不能自己再转: While the motor is running, tap Stop: it should stop within 1 second and must not restart by itself after Stop is released.
电机转着时 Shift+点击把启动锁住按下，再按停止：电机应该停（或点\"演示全: While the motor is running, hold Start pressed with Shift+click, then press Stop: the motor should stop (or click "Demo All").
点这一项的\"演示\"：系统模拟热继电器过载（M1_OL_OK 变 0），电机要: Click "Demo" for this item: the system simulates a thermal overload relay trip (M1_OL_OK changes to 0). The motor must stop immediately and must not restart by itself after the relay is reset.
电机转的时候运行灯亮，按停止以后运行灯灭: The run indicator is on while the motor is running and turns off when Stop is pressed.
按启动后电机没有运行: The motor does not run after Start is pressed.
运行时指示灯没亮: The indicator lamp does not light while the motor is running.
松开启动按钮后电机停了（没有自锁）: The motor stops when the Start button is released (no latching).
按停止后电机没停: The motor does not stop when Stop is pressed.
停止后指示灯没灭: The indicator lamp does not turn off after the motor stops.
松开停止按钮后电机自己又启动了: The motor starts by itself again when the Stop button is released.
停止以后再按启动，电机没有重新运行: The motor does not restart when Start is pressed after stopping.
启动和停止同时按下时电机还在运行（应停止优先）: The motor keeps running when Start and Stop are pressed at the same time (Stop should take priority).
热继电器动作后输出没有断开: The output does not turn off after the thermal overload relay trips.
热继电器复位后电机自己重新启动了: The motor restarts by itself after the thermal overload relay is reset.
热继电器复位后再按启动，电机没有重新运行: The motor does not restart when Start is pressed after the thermal overload relay is reset.
启保停：启动并联自锁，串常闭停止和热继电器: Start-Stop-Hold: Start with a parallel seal-in circuit, in series with NC Stop and the thermal overload relay
电机运行中突然停止，M1_OL_OK 变为 0，复位前按启动无效: The motor stops unexpectedly while running. M1_OL_OK changes to 0, and pressing Start has no effect until it is reset.
按启动没有任何反应，输入 START 一直为 0: Pressing Start does nothing; the START input remains 0.
停止按钮断线：STOP 一直为 0，电机无法启动（常闭接法断线时停机，是安全的）: Stop button wire break: STOP remains 0, and the motor cannot start. (With NC wiring, a broken wire stops the motor, which is safe.)
停止按钮触点粘连：按停止没反应（危险！）: Stop button contacts are stuck closed: pressing Stop has no effect (dangerous!).
电机在转但运行灯不亮: The motor is running, but the run indicator lamp is off.
